title: Hematologic Profile, Vit. B12 and Folic Acid in Cirrhotics Received Sofosbuvir and Daclatasvir With or Without Ribavirin
brief_summary: Use of Ribavirin could affect hematologic profile of the patients negatively. With advent of new antiviral therapy, the preexisting hematologic changes may alter or corrected after treatment. However, this point is still not properly studied.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients known to have HCV-related liver cirrhosis and candidate for therapy with Sofosbuvir and Daclatasvir with or without Ribavirin

Exclusion Criteria:

* Chronic hepatitis due causes other than chronic HCV infection
* Coinfection with HIV or HBV infection
* Hepatocellular carcinoma
* Decompensated cirrhosis
study_population: Fifty patients were diagnosed to have HCV-related liver cirrhosis and candidate for anti- HCV therapy
